Text: When I Am The Advocate... is in your Ring, -5F. Reverse any ACE or Unique card, or when overturned (even during the Pre-match phase), -10F and reverse any non-damage card effect.

Your Baby Carriage and Heat actions are Permanent, your blank maneuvers are Heat, and when they are successful, choose 1: Arsenal Search 1- blank Heat maneuvers or shuffle 1- Ringside cards into your Arsenal.

name: A Devilish Smile
Text: Draw cards equal to the number of Fan Favorite cards in your Ring (max. 5). Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of Heel cards in your Ring (max. 5).

name: A Hero's Welcome
Text: Requirement: WWE Homecoming is in your Ring. That card and this card do not take up Pre-match slots and cannot be blanked. Replace -2 with +2 on your Hometown Hero and your reversal's Fortitude cannot be modified by your opponent. ACE: You may discard 2 cards listed on WWE Homecoming to reverse a card that is not the first or second card played this turn. ACE: During your turn you may hide Hometown Hero, shuffle any number of Ringside or RFG cards listed on WWE Homecoming  (when you pack a Superstar-specific card with WWE Homecoming in text, max. 8), and then RFG this card.

Text: When played, you may Bury 2 Hand cards and draw that many cards; if you do not, this card is Multi.

name: Air Pillman
Text: Can only be played after a successful maneuver. When played after From The Top Rope, cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may discard it and Arsenal Search 1- High Risk.

name: Alexa's Playground
Text: When packing this card you are not an NXT Superstar, but you can pack Let Me In (reveal it when this card is played). Can be played from Ringside and during the Venue phase. New Ability: 'When your maneuver without 'reversed' in the text is unsuccessful, you may put it into your Backstage. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your opponent's cards are considered Superstar-specific for Let Me In.'

Logos: Highlight of the Night, Sexy Beast
Text: *Can only be revealed when you play SAVE_US.X29, that card is Permanent. When packing this card you can pack 2 additional Pre-match cards. When your Superstar-specific action is unsuccessful, you may put that card into your Ring and then hide World Tour '05. When you are Highlight of the Night, your opponent cannot play more than 1 action per turn, and once during any turn, when he successfully plays a non-action that is not his first card of the turn, put 1- non-Reversal Ring or RFG Backlash cards into your Backlash; this cannot be prevented.

Once during each of your turns you may RFG 3 Ringside cards and when your next card played this turn is a non-Run-in, non-Submission maneuver, it is considered to have 'Rope' in the text.

Text: Cannot be blanked. ACE: When your opponent's maneuver is successful, you may RFG your top Arsenal card and his maneuver is -3D.

Your maneuvers without a reversal restriction from your effects that are -#F are also +#D. Logos: The Largest Athlete in Sports Entertainment
Text: When you play A Giant Shift in Power, hide this card. When your Fortitude Rating is greater than the printed Fortitude of your played non-Multi Strike, Grapple, or Submission without a reversal restriction from your effect, it is +#D (#= the maneuver's printed Fortitude), and its damage cannot be modified by your other effects. When your opponent moves a card from your Ring with your Ability, before you end your turn you may play a Superstar-specific action from hand or Backlash, and it can only be reversed by non-hybrid cards. After your Draw Segment, you may reveal your hand. If you have no maneuvers, put a random Ringside maneuver into your hand.

Put any Backstage Mid-match cards into your Backlash. Before you overturn for your Ability, Bury or Stack 2- Ringside cards; this cannot be prevented.

Text: When your opponent's maneuver is successful and you have 15- cards in your Arsenal, you may shuffle this card into your Arsenal and end his turn. When overturned, reverse any Unique maneuver. Text: Cannot be played from Backlash. This card requires 3 reversals to reverse instead of 2. Your opponent puts all of his Ring cards into his Ringside. Put all of your Ring Arsenal cards into your Backlash, and shuffle all your non-Superstar-specific Ring Backlash cards into your Arsenal. End your turn.

Text: Once per turn, when you have greater Fortitude and you shuffle random cards into your Arsenal, Recover 1- random Ringside card. When you have equal or lower Fortitude and you would overturn cards for Don't Call Me Crazy!, you may instead Promo: 3.

Text: When packing this card, you may pack Edge's Spear, Edge Kick, Downward Spiral, Edge-O-Matic, and Unprettier. Each turn, you may skip your Draw Segment; if you do, your opponent discards 1 card (when you have fewer hand cards, he discards randomly). Text: Can only be packed by an NXT UK Superstar or Pete Dunne. Cannot be packed when packing NXT Arrival or ECW cards. Can be played if your opponent has a Venue in his Ring. When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver and damage is applied, you may put any number of cards in your Ringside overturned for damage under this card. Your maneuvers played as a Counter are +1D for every 2 cards under this card, and when they are successful, Bury 2- random cards under this card and put the remaining cards under this card into your Ringside. When one of the chosen cards is Fan Favorite or Cheater, he discards an additional random card. When this card is in your Ring or Ringside and you draw for Cobb County, Georgia, you may Bury this card.

Text: Shuffle 3- Ringside cards into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent plays with his hand revealed. During his turn, he may overturn 4 cards and then put this card into your Ringside. When this card is in your Ringside, you may RFG 1 Ring Superstar-specific card and then put this card into your Backlash.

Text: All players' Fortitude Surge is Permanent, cannot be modified by other effects, and can only be played in response to a card or ACE when their opponent is modifying their reversal cards. You may RFG it from Ringside and your reversal cards are unaffected by Fortitude modification for the rest of the turn; this effect and its ACE are not a response. Text: When this card would be RFG, put it into your Backlash or Bury it instead. When successful, your opponent discards 2 random cards; when T-BAR's Intimidating Presence is face-up, double that number.

Text: Can only be packed by The Fiend. When packing this card you can pack 1 Throwback Bray Wyatt Superstar card and 1 non-Throwback Bray Wyatt Superstar card in your Arsenal (They are blank when they are not in your Backstage). During your turn when you are The Fiend, you may RFG/Ringside/Hand Search 1 Bray Wyatt and put it on top of your Superstar card, you are now considered that Superstar until Bray Wyatt is not revealed. When the reversed card did not have your opponent's logo, he randomly RFG 2 Arsenal cards.

Text: When your 'Judo' card is successful, you may reduce it to D:0, and your opponent cannot play reversals to your next 'Head' or 'BASH' maneuver this turn. When your opponent has 10+ greater Fortitude than you, and you play a 'Judo' maneuver, choose # random cards from his hand, where # = his number of Ring maneuvers, and your card cannot be reversed by the chosen cards.

Your Foreign Object and 'Punch' maneuvers do not take up Mid-match Ring slots, discard 1 less card for your Ability, when your maneuver played from hand is unsuccessful, you may Bury it regardless of other effects; and when you have 10+ lower Fortitude than your opponent, you may use your Ability as if the maneuver was successful.

name: Free Agent

Text: This card is considered a High Risk for your effects. Can only be played after a 5D+ maneuver. Cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face. When this card is successful and it is not reversed from Arsenal, your opponent must Promo: 20 and you may shuffle Divine Intervention from Ringside or RFG into your Arsenal.

If your opponent's successful Hand maneuver with a reversal restriction from his card is not reversed from Arsenal you may put this card from hand (or, if it was D:7+, from Ringside) into your Ring and end his turn. Text: When you have 3+ cards under your Superstar and you play this with a Chop card, cannot be reversed from Backlash. Shuffle 3- Ringside cards into your Arsenal.

name: WALTER's Power Bomb
Text: Can only be reversed from Arsenal if you have 6+ cards under your Superstar. Shuffle 3- Ringside cards into your Arsenal.

name: WALTER's Shotgun Chop
Text: When this card is unsuccessful, put it under your Superstar instead of any other location. You may play this card from under your Superstar as if from hand; if you do, can be reversed as if it were a Strike. When this card is under your Superstar, it is considered to be in your hand for The Bull from Vienna. Your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of cards under your Superstar.

name: WALTER's Shotgun Dropkick
Text: When played after a successful maneuver or as a Counter (Set-Up or 5D+ maneuver) cannot be reversed from hand by non-Superstar-specific cards.  When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this card is -4F. Discard 1 card and your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: WALTER's Sleeper
Text: Arsenal Search 1 non-Superstar-specific action. When your next card played is Maintain Hold or From the Top Rope, it cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: WALTER's Splash
Text: Cannot be reversed from Arsenal when you have 4+ Superstar-specific Ring maneuvers. When played after From the Top Rope, or you have 9+ cards under your Superstar, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead.

name: WARNING... WARNING... WARNING...
Text: Your opponent's Backstage Politics is blank. Ignore 'Action' in your Ability. When you reverse a non-action with your Ability, your opponent continues his turn. When you would Bury your hand for your Ability, you may first Stack 1 hand card.

name: Watch Me Shine
Text: You may not flip cards face-up. When your card reverses (even from Arsenal) you may put it face-down in your Ring. Your Fortitude is +1 for each maneuver type and face-down card in your Ring. When you play a printed non-Multi maneuver without a reversal restriction from your card, you may RFG 1 non-Multi Ringside Strike, Grapple, or Submission, and your played maneuver is now Multi and gains that type until reversed or resolved. If it is unsuccessful, Bury 1- non-Divine RFG card.

name: We Want The Smoke!
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have lower Fortitude or fewer Hand cards, the first maneuver played during each of your turns cannot be reversed from Backlash. When you successfully play a High Risk, you may Promo: 2. ACE: You may RFG this card to reverse any ACE and your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Wolfe's Death Valley Driver
Text: As a maneuver, -5F; when played, you may Promo: 3 and Bury the cards not chosen. Put 1- Ringside Backlash cards into your Backlash. As a reversal, -3D.

name: Working Class Hero
Text: When packing this card you are a WCW Superstar, your Superstar-specific cards are WCW and do not take up Ring slots. Cannot be packed when packing Managed by Sapphire. Cannot be blanked or prevented from being played by your opponent. Can be played from Ringside. Your Ability gains: 'Your 'Classic' cards are WCW, and when successful, Bury 1- Ringside cards or draw 1 card.'.

name: Wrestling With Shadows
Text: When packing this card you are a WCW Superstar, your Superstar-specific cards are WCW, and you cannot pack 'McMahon' cards. When revealed, look at your opponent's Arsenal and Backlash. Your opponent cannot win the game via win condition from his cards, or prevent a Pinfall Victory. Your Superstar-specific ACE cannot be reversed.

name: You Don't Even Go Here!
Text: As an action, Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique maneuver, then shuffle this card into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Maneuver card. When your opponent has a ECW, WCW, NXT, or nWo Ring or Backstage Card, reverse any card instead.

name: Your Time Is Up My Time Is Now!
Text: When packing this card, you cannot pack Backslide or Inside Cradle, but you can pack 10- Throwback maneuvers in your Backstage that are either Superstar-specific or F: 0 and non-Unique; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put 1 of those cards in your hand and shuffle the rest into your Arsenal. Your Superstar-specific Pre-match and Mid-match cards do not take up Ring slots. Once during each of your turns you may play a maneuver underneath 12 Rounds as if from hand. If it is unsuccessful choose 1: draw 2-, continue your turn, or when you have no Ring Five Knuckle Shuffle, you may Arsenal Search that card and put it into your Ring.

name: You’re All Bluff and No Stuff
Text: Can only be packed by Razor Ramon. Your opponent discards 2 cards and overturns 4 cards. When this card is in your Ring, and he would move your Ring card to another location, you may put this card into your Backlash instead.
